Grain Department
FVC has 20 storage facilities in 17 locations. 15 locations in Nebraska: Benkelman, Beverly, Chappell, Culbertson, Dix, Enders, Grant, Imperial, Kimball, Lodgepole, McCook, Palisade, Perry, Venango and Wauneta and 2 locations in Wyoming: Burns and Pine Bluffs. With a total storage capacity of nearly 40 million bushels, FVC is well equipped to easily handle peak harvest times.
